title: Saudi Energy secures $4.22bln Murabaha facility
summary: The facility has a seven-year tenor
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
The facility has a seven-year tenor

ZAWYA

Tadawul-listed Saudi Energy has secured a SAR 15.8 billion ($4.22 billion) Murabaha financing facility from a consortium of seven local lenders.
